note: Per-frame pose scripts for the v3 redraw. Frame counts, phase breaks and timing semantics match the shipped atlas so combat data and tests stay valid. Layout tall = 512x1024 columns, wide = 768x1024 columns; both keep the approved 1024 px figure scale.

walk.intro: In-place forward walk cycle that keeps the approved middle guard: both hands on the hilt in front of the navel, blade pointing forward and up. Torso, head and blade stay steady (at most 6 px of bob); the pelvis stays at the same X in every frame. It is a seamless loop, not a story of moving right.
frames: Contact: near leg reaches forward RIGHT with the heel touching the ground, far leg behind on its toes; guard held.
Down: weight moves onto the near foot, both knees bend a little, far heel lifts.
Passing: far foot swings forward close to the ground under the pelvis, near leg supports; body at its highest.
Up: far foot travels ahead of the support foot, about to land.
Opposite contact: far leg now forward RIGHT with the heel down, near leg behind on its toes (the legs swapped compared with frame 1).
Opposite down: weight moves onto the far foot, knees bend a little, near heel lifts.
Opposite passing: near foot swings forward under the pelvis, far leg supports; body at its highest.
Opposite up: near foot travels ahead, about to land; flows directly into frame 1.

stand_light.intro: Standing light slash (5A): a quick diagonal cut that starts and ends in the approved middle guard.
frames: Startup: from the approved guard take a short step forward with the near foot and lift the blade slightly back toward the far shoulder.
Wind-up peak: blade raised up and back above the near shoulder, both hands on the hilt, torso coiled, eyes on the target.
Active: fast diagonal slash downward and forward, both arms extended, blade level with the chest pointing RIGHT, short lunge on the near leg, mouth slightly open.
Follow-through: blade continues low forward and down past the hips, body leaning forward over the near knee.
Recovery: draw the blade back up toward the guard, weight returning over the centre.
Return: back in the approved middle guard, almost identical to input image 1.

water_slash.intro: Water Breathing First Form, Water Surface Slash (236A/C): a powerful two-handed horizontal sweep. Draw no water or effects; the game adds them.
frames: Startup: from the approved guard inhale, lower the stance and turn the torso away, blade drawn back horizontally to the LEFT at waist height with both hands.
Deep coil: rear knee bent, blade fully behind the body pointing LEFT, torso twisted, focused eyes.
Launch: push off the rear foot, hips begin rotating forward, the blade starts sweeping from behind.
Release: wide horizontal slash sweeping forward through the front of the body at chest height, long front lunge.
Full extension: arms and blade fully extended straight forward to the RIGHT at shoulder height, long lunge, mouth open in a shout.
Follow-through: blade continues past to the right and slightly up, torso fully rotated forward.
Recover: the lunge holds while the blade drifts back toward the body.
Rise from the lunge and bring the hilt back toward the navel.
Settle back into the approved middle guard, almost identical to input image 1.

walk_back.intro: In-place backward walk cycle keeping the approved middle guard (both hands on the hilt in front of the navel, blade pointing forward and up). The body faces RIGHT while stepping toward the LEFT; torso, head and blade stay steady; pelvis at the same X in every frame; seamless loop.
frames: Contact: far leg reaches back LEFT with the toes touching, near leg forward bearing weight.
Down: weight moves back onto the far leg, knees bend a little, near heel lifts.
Passing: near foot draws back under the pelvis close to the ground; body at its highest.
Up: near foot travels behind the support foot, about to land.
Opposite contact: near leg reaches back LEFT toes down, far leg forward bearing weight.
Opposite down: weight moves back onto the near leg, far heel lifts.
Opposite passing: far foot draws back under the pelvis; body at its highest.
Opposite up: far foot travels behind, about to land; flows into the first frame of the cycle.

crouch.intro: Crouching from the guard, blade kept forward.
frames: Start: the approved middle guard (both hands on the hilt in front of the navel, blade pointing forward and up), knees beginning to bend.
Half crouch: hips lowering, torso leaning slightly forward, blade still forward.
Full crouch: deep knee bend with the rear knee near the ground, torso low and compact, both hands on the hilt, blade pointing forward at waist height.

guard.intro: Standing block with the katana held up as a shield.
frames: Ready: the approved middle guard (both hands on the hilt in front of the navel, blade pointing forward and up), weight shifting back.
Block impact: blade held diagonally in front of the face and chest with both hands, flat side forward, rear knee bent, teeth clenched, slight lean back.
Hold: the same block a moment later, braced and steady, eyes on the opponent.
Ready: crouching, blade forward low.
Block impact: crouched low, blade held horizontally in front of the shins and knees with both hands, braced, teeth clenched.
Hold: the same crouching block, braced and steady.

hit.intro: Taking a hit while standing; keep the katana in hand.
frames: Impact: head snaps back, torso bends backward, eyes squeezed, mouth open in pain, blade hand low.
Recoil: stumble back on the rear foot, shoulders hunched, grimace.
Recover: regain balance, knees bent, blade coming back up.
Back to guard: nearly the approved middle guard (both hands on the hilt in front of the navel, blade pointing forward and up) with a pained look.

knockdown.intro: Knocked off his feet onto his back; keep the katana in his right hand.
frames: Hit hard: body flung backward, feet leaving the ground, arms thrown forward.
Falling: body diagonal in the air, legs up, head going down toward the LEFT.
Impact: back hits the ground, legs raised, haori spreading.
Bounce: lying on his back, knees bent, slight lift from the bounce.
Down: lying flat on his back, head to the LEFT, feet to the RIGHT, eyes closed, katana loose beside him.

throw.intro: Grab attempt (whiff animation of the close throw).
frames: Start: from the approved middle guard (both hands on the hilt in front of the navel, blade pointing forward and up) the left hand leaves the hilt.
Reach: lunge forward reaching out with the open left hand at chest height, blade held back in the right hand.
Full reach: arm fully extended forward grabbing at air.
Miss: hand closes on nothing, weight overextended forward.
Pull back: drawing the hand back, rebalancing.
Recover: back to the approved middle guard (both hands on the hilt in front of the navel, blade pointing forward and up).
Lower the blade, exhale, relaxed stance.
The blade swings down to the side in a short flick.
Guide the blade tip toward the scabbard on the left hip.
Slide the blade into the scabbard, left hand holding the scabbard.
Blade fully sheathed, hand on the hilt, standing upright.
Standing upright facing slightly toward the viewer, gentle determined smile, hands relaxed, katana sheathed.

stand_heavy.intro: Standing heavy slash (5C): a big overhead-to-forward cut, starting and ending in the guard.
frames: Startup: from the approved middle guard (both hands on the hilt in front of the navel, blade pointing forward and up) step forward and raise the blade.
Wind-up: blade raised high above and behind the head with both hands, torso arched back.
Active: powerful downward-forward cut, blade sweeping in front at shoulder height, long lunge.
Extension: blade extended forward and slightly down, arms straight, deep lunge, shout.
Recovery: the lunge holds, blade drifting low, breathing out.
Return: pulling back up toward the approved middle guard (both hands on the hilt in front of the navel, blade pointing forward and up).

crouch_light.intro: Crouching light slash (2A): a quick low cut from a crouch.
frames: Crouch ready: deep crouch, blade forward low.
Draw back: blade pulled back beside the hip, still crouching.
Active: quick horizontal slash at shin height, arms extended forward, crouch held.
Follow-through: blade past the front, low.
Recover: blade returning toward the body, crouch held.
Crouch ready again: deep crouch, blade forward low.

crouch_heavy.intro: Crouching heavy slash (2C): a rising diagonal slash from a deep crouch.
frames: Crouch ready, blade low.
Wind-up: blade drawn back low behind the rear hip, deep crouch, torso twisted.
Active: rising diagonal slash from low to shoulder height while STAYING in the deep crouch (hips low, rear knee near the ground); only the arms and blade rise.
Extension: blade high in front at head height, arms extended upward and forward, the body still in the deep crouch with the hips low - never standing up.
Recovery: blade coming down, settling back into the crouch.
Crouch ready again, blade low.

air_light.intro: Air light slash (jA): a quick cut while airborne. Airborne in every frame: no floor contact, legs bent beneath him.
frames: Airborne ready: knees bent, blade held forward.
Wind-up: blade drawn back to the far shoulder, knees tucked.
Active: quick horizontal slash in front at chest height, arms extended.
Extension: follow-through at full reach.
Recover: pulling the blade back, legs extending downward.
Airborne ready for landing: legs extended down, blade forward.

air_heavy.intro: Air heavy slash (jC): a big downward cut while airborne. Airborne in every frame: no floor contact, legs bent beneath him.
frames: Airborne ready: knees bent, blade held forward.
Wind-up: blade raised high overhead, knees tucked, torso arched.
Active: powerful downward diagonal cut in front, blade pointing down and forward.
Extension: follow-through at full reach.
Recover: pulling the blade back, legs extending downward.
Airborne ready for landing: legs extended down, blade forward.

water_wheel.intro: Water Breathing Second Form, Water Wheel (623A/C): a rising forward somersault that slashes in a full vertical circle. Draw no water or effects.
frames: Startup: crouch from the approved middle guard (both hands on the hilt in front of the navel, blade pointing forward and up), blade lowered behind.
Spring: legs push off, blade swinging up from low behind.
Rise: body leaves the ground, blade sweeping up in front, knees tucked.
Flip begins: body rotating forward, head going down, blade circling over the top.
Upside down: head at the bottom, legs up, blade extended making the circle.
Rotation: body sideways continuing the forward flip, blade sweeping down in front.
Completing: legs coming over, blade finishing the circle below.
Upright in the air: knees tucked, blade forward and down.
Descending: legs extending downward, blade held forward.
Landing: feet touch down in a crouch, blade low.
Absorb: crouch, blade low and forward.
Rise back to the approved middle guard (both hands on the hilt in front of the navel, blade pointing forward and up).

dash_forward.intro: Forward dash: a fast low run with the blade held low and back, looping.

Stride: front knee high, rear leg stretched, haori flowing back.
Contact: front foot lands, body low and forward.
Passing: rear leg swings through, torso forward.
Opposite push: the other leg extended behind.
Opposite stride: the other knee high, haori streaming back.
Opposite contact.
Opposite passing; flows into the first frame.

dash_back.intro: Backstep: a quick hop backward while facing RIGHT, blade kept forward.

Push off the front foot, body moving LEFT, front knee rising.
Airborne hop backward, legs tucked, blade forward.
Still airborne, rear foot reaching back LEFT to land.
Rear foot lands, front leg still raised.
Front foot comes down, knees bent absorbing.
Settling, slight crouch, blade forward.
Back in the approved middle guard (both hands on the hilt in front of the navel, blade pointing forward and up).

jump_forward.intro: Forward somersault jump: a full flip in the air holding the katana tight to the body.
